role.title: OT Risk and Consequence Analyst
role.description: STUB. Analyzes OT cyber risk in terms of physical consequence, using consequence-driven and Cyber-Informed Engineering methods and process hazard analysis.
role.overlaps_method: Computed: NICE roles sharing the most statements with this role, excluding the roles it extends.

citations.locator: Appendix D.2.7 INL CIE and CCE (PDF p. 215)

open_questions: Draws on DD-WRL-009 tasks T2035 (process hazard analysis) and T2042 (attack scenarios with physical consequence). Should it extend DD-WRL-009?
Should this role be drafted around the Cyber-Informed Engineering competency area (PC-OT-001), with PT-OT-0027 and PS-OT-0009 as core?
